title: Not happy about the presentaties and lay out
body: I reality think there is much room for improvement. I would have thought better things would come from Google. Nowhere do I see a complete overview of one month, not even of one week, not even of one day on my screen. Extremely frustrating. Even the one day view only allows you to see certain hours, unless you scroll. But I don't want to scroll. Especially on an i-pad there is room enough for a 'traditional' calendar with a matrix for a months and activities in a box for each day. The current 'planning' lay out leaves me completely confused. Also the reminders are set by default and terribly irritating to be woken up at midnight to tell me I have a meeting the next afternoon.... Who invents such app of torture?

title: iPhone only, why no iPad version?
body: Looks awfully on my iPad Retina. Why is there only an iPhone version of this app? World's most famous and biggest Internet company has splendid and completely free apps, in both smartphones and tablets versions... Except for this very useful agenda app. Did you know that the built-in agenda of iOS really sucks? It constantly crashes, all the time, since iOS 7. In  the meantime I'm using iOS 9.2.1 and yet, Apple still hasn't fixed the crashing problem in their own default agenda app! I can't believe this! Really stupid from Apple to overlook this problem... Google Agenda could be the solution to this iPad flaw, IF the goodwill would present, because now Google left iPad users in the cold. The existing iPhone version runs on an iPad too, correct, but like all other iPhone apps it looks ugly on an iPad, and lacks features that are present on an iPhone but missing on iPad. Could you please do something about this?
